The 72 pairs of a saturated-star row and a kept daophot row in the vetted F212N catalogs of o105, o118, o130 and o138.
A pair is an appended saturated-star row and a daophot row within 0.108 arcsec that the replacement did not overwrite, with a flux of 0.2 to 0.8 of the saturated-star flux.
tile = tile; ra, dec = position of the pair in degrees; x, y = pixel of the pair in the i2d mosaic of the tile; sep = separation in arcsec; ratio = flux of the daophot row over flux of the saturated-star row;
flux_sat, flux_dao = their fluxes; prod_max, prod_min = maximum and minimum of the residual in the 7 x 7 pixel window around the pair in the production render, MJy/sr;
run_max, run_min = the same in the unmasked render of the run; data_peak = peak of the data in the window, MJy/sr.

tile ra dec x y sep ratio flux_sat flux_dao prod_max prod_min run_max run_min data_peak
